status: Local exploratory protocol fixed before external detector evaluation; dataset and article inspected beforehand; not external preregistration or independent confirmation
eligibility: All 5885 source rows are inventoried. Behavioral evaluation requires all 11 members of a base group to parse and lower to bounded unitary circuits. Only terminal measurements/barriers may be removed; classical mappings are retained in provenance. Reset, mid-circuit measurements and control flow are excluded explicitly. Unused classical registers are harmless. No selection on observed detector success or source sensitivity metrics.
observable: Whole-register little-endian computational outcomes after optional input preparation and measurement-basis rotations. This differs from source programs measuring a subset of qubits; do not claim exact reproduction of authors' sensitivity experiment.
noise_model: Native local depolarization p per lowered one-qubit gate, min(2p,1) per CX, symmetric readout p. Noisy cost is that of the declared primitive decomposition, not source-native gates or real hardware.
allocation: fixed_0Z uses 768 shots; each portfolio probe uses 256. All portfolio rules share reference/calibration/evaluation counts. Fixed baseline has separate matched-shot calibration. Every base and noise context has its own clean references and calibration.
equivalent_control: Append two X gates before probe basis rotations, reusing the original calibration deliberately as a raw-context stress control. This is not claimed to be a newly calibrated approved variant.
classical: Report raw representation changes and actual SDK inspect decisions. Inconclusive means withhold, not proven malicious. A trusted golden circuit is additional information unavailable to the authors' single-circuit text classifier.
baseline: Reuse the authors' archived GroupKFold out-of-fold predictions for all eight text pipelines; do not claim retraining or exact reproduction. Verify sample labels and complete base-group separation across folds. Compare on precisely the same eligible IDs, and separately report full-source metrics.
hypothesis: Exploratory transfer assessment: does the fixed portfolio improve macro-averaged infected detection by at least 0.20 over fixed_0Z at the same evaluation-shot budget, with every tested base context clean Wilson95 upper <=0.10? Report each noise separately; preserve a failed conjunction. No claim of >=90% detection for every insertion or novel quantum security guarantee.
statistics: Per-case conditional Wilson95 intervals over sampled decisions. Overall detection and clean rates macro-average within base before across bases. Report mean fold metrics on author-grouped folds and paired base-cluster bootstrap intervals for portfolio-minus-fixed TPR (2000 resamples, separate RNG). No pooled binomial CI treating related variants/repetitions as independent applications. Published classifier and RASQP labels/knowledge are different tasks; comparisons are descriptive.
reporting: Record source and protocol hashes, per-sample file hashes, author group/fold IDs, parsing/exclusion reasons, conversion parity, raw reference/calibration/evaluation counts and seeds, thresholds, all case outcomes and resource costs. Preserve native-v1 unchanged. Hardware, industrial deployment and general instrumentation are not evaluated.
